name: Rumoi (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Rumoi city emblem in grey and yellow: a grey stylised cloud-like frame bearing a yellow device of two characters.
history: Municipal flag of Rumoi, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 21 June 1968; the emblem dates from 16 December 1964.

features.role: Rumoi city emblem — a grey stylised cloud-like frame bearing a yellow device of two characters
